content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, assignment).**

- **Clause located:** § 10.3 Assignment (p0063) — a bare successors-and-assigns statement with no consent mechanics in either direction.
- **Gap vs. preferred position:** No affiliate/M&A-successor carve-out confirming our right to assign, and no restriction on HDI, which as drafted leaves HDI free to assign the hosting relationship (potentially to a competitor of ours).
- **No walk-away trigger:** searches confirm the agreement contains no "change of control" language, and the termination provisions (90-day mutual notice plus the termination payment mechanic) create no HDI exit or re-pricing right on a change of control of the Company — notable given HDI and the Company are related entities.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** appends to § 10.3 our free assignment right to affiliates/M&A successors, an HDI assignment restriction requiring our consent (not unreasonably withheld) with a competitor bar, and a confirmation that a Company change of control is not an assignment and gives HDI no termination, suspension or re-pricing right. The comment offers the mutual notice-based fallback.
